workflows.name: image-qwen21
workflows.label: Qwen Image 2.1
workflows.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo. Text-to-image, multi-image edit, true-mask inpaint, outpaint; native RGBA via prompt template.

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Leave empty for a random seed each time

parameters.label: Reference resolution
parameters.description: Reference images are scaled to roughly this edge; the output follows the first reference image

edit.label: Multi-image edit
edit.description: Instructed edits and blending across 1-4 reference images

inpaint.label: Inpaint
inpaint.description: Source plus a binary mask, constrained in latent space, only inside the mask

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

outpaint.label: Outpaint
outpaint.description: Source plus padding on all four sides, filled in by the Qwen outpaint LoRA

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

t2i.label: Text to image
t2i.description: Text to image with no reference images; native transparency supported

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

workflows.name: image-moss-sft-8step
workflows.label: MOSS-Image fast 8-step
workflows.description: MOSS-Image SFT bf16 + Qwen3.5 9B + FLUX.2 VAE with a built-in 8-step DMD LoRA; 8 steps / cfg 1 / euler simple by default, tuned for speed.

negative.default: worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Leave empty for a random seed each time

workflows.name: image-qwen21-angle
workflows.label: Qwen Image 2.1 multi-angle
workflows.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo + Qwen Multiangle Camera. Local angle regeneration with 0-360 horizontal, -30-60 vertical and zoom.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Leave empty for a random seed each time

parameters.description: At most 7 at 8 steps

workflows.name: video-rife
workflows.label: RIFE 帧插值
workflows.description: RIFE frame interpolation: 2× or 3× the frame rate of an existing clip. The audio track passes through. The source is assumed to be 24fps, which is what the canvas's own clips are.

parameters.label: 倍数
parameters.description: RIFE VFI 只支持 2× 和 3×
